trigger.name: prefresh_capture
trigger.match: feels less tired after your refreshment

trigger.name: sheal_capture
trigger.match: A warm feeling fills your body

muclient.script:
require 'aardwolf_colors'
pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0 sheal_count = 0
function colorsToAnsiNote(data) return AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(data)) end
function pheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) pheal = pheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = 0 end
function prefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) prefresh = prefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = 0 end
function sheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) sheal = sheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = sheal_count + 1 end
function srefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) srefresh = srefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = 0 end
function pheal_trigger_end() report = ""
if pheal > 0 or sheal > 0 or prefresh > 0 or srefresh > 0 then report = "@w<< In: @G[@W".. sheal .. "@G] @w| @C[@W" .. srefresh .. "@C] @w>> << Out: @G[@W".. pheal .. "@G] @w| @C[@W" .. prefresh .. "@C] @w>>" colorsToAnsiNote(report) pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0 end
sheal_count = 0 end
function blank_trigger(name, line, args) if sheal_count > 1 then DeleteLines(1) end end
function full_trigger() sheal_count = 0 end
